newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA KAIRINOS CHANGES LISTING NAME TO KAIFOOD.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA KAIRINOS CHANGES LISTING NAME TO KAIFOOD.

text.p: South Africa's Kairinos Foods Ltd, which is to be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) next month, said on Friday that its abbreviated listing name had been changed to Kaifood from K-Foods before.

The firm has rescheduled its listing to July 22 after an objection was lodged with the JSE over the usage of the abbreviation K-Foods. In resolving the issue the exchange had decided to extend both the offer period and the listing date.
Kairinos again said that offer period had been extended to July 15 from June 18 previously.
